Instead of playing the video and observing the scenes to count the bird species, it only interacted with the webpage interface (scrolling, pausing) and relied on reading YouTube comments. While a comment mentioned "12 Emperor fledglings" and "1 Adelie," the WebSurfer did not verify this by watching the video itself to see if those birds were on screen simultaneously or if other species were present. By basing its final conclusion (which was derived by the Orchestrator/Assistant from this incomplete analysis) on unverified comment text rather than direct visual observation of the video, the WebSurfer made a critical error in data gathering, leading to an incorrect answer.
